name: Carbon Based Studio AJAX Add to Cart
author: carbonbasedstudio

sections.description:
WooCommerce adds to cart without a page reload on shop pages, but not on single product pages. Carbon Based Studio AJAX Add to Cart fills that gap. Customers add simple and variable products from the product page and see the message straight away, with no reload.

Features

  • Standard WooCommerce forms – Works with default form.cart and form.variations_form on single product pages (enabled by default).
  • Custom form profiles – Map non-standard purchase boxes with your own CSS selectors for the form, variation ID, parent product ID, quantity, and attributes.
  • Notice HTML in AJAX responses – Success and error messages are returned as HTML, not only through cart fragments.
  • Optional cart fragments – Mini-cart and other fragment targets can update after a successful add.
  • Behaviour controls – Loading indicator modes (theme spinner, plugin spinner, text, or custom), single-submit guard, scroll-to-notice option, and post-add behaviour.
  • Compatibility options – Normal or conservative submit handling, extra form fields, optional send-all form fields for add-ons, and an automatic warning when another AJAX add-to-cart plugin looks active.
  • Developer filters – Extend profiles, payloads, notices, cart item data, and form binding.
  • In-plugin Information tab – Closed topics matching each settings tab.

Requires WooCommerce. Settings are under Carbon Based > AJAX Add to Cart.

Supported product types

Simple and variable products on single product pages. Grouped and external products are not handled in the current release.

Who is this for?

  • Store owners who want a smoother add-to-cart experience on product pages.
  • Sites using a custom theme purchase box that still posts like a WooCommerce cart form.
  • Developers who need a small, filterable AJAX layer instead of theme-only JavaScript.

User guide

Setup, settings, and custom forms are covered in the AJAX Add to Cart user guide.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin from the WordPress plugins directory, or upload the carbon-based-ajax-add-to-cart folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate Carbon Based Studio AJAX Add to Cart.
  4. Open Carbon Based > AJAX Add to Cart, turn on Enable AJAX add to cart, and save.
  5. Test on a single product page. For custom markup, add a profile under Compatibility > Custom forms. Details are in the user guide.
